bullets.text: Free Developer Registration - Individual developers can now publish apps on the **Microsoft Store** without onboarding fees.
Agent Factory Insights - New open standards like **MCP** and **A2A** enhance agent collaboration across platforms.
Flexible Work Update - **Microsoft** updates its flexible work policy to three days in the office for better collaboration.
AI Actions in File Explorer - New **AI** features in **Windows 11** streamline file management and enhance user experience.
Mandatory MFA Phase 2 - Starting October 2025, **Azure** enforces multifactor authentication for enhanced security.
